messages.subject: External file possibilities with new Layout features
parts:
Hi
  Love the new options and am looking to use them to collect together many shiny apps
However, this potentially will result in extremely large ui,R, global.R and server.R files
Is there a way of avoiding this. 

I have placed a toy example on github 
https://gist.github.com/pssguy/8062364

shiny::runGist("8062364") to view

which combines a couple of your examples

I am looking to extract out all the code within each tabPanel of the ui and also
create seperate files for  the independent code in server.R
